# /excipient_selection — Excipient Selection Expert

Send one task to **A06, the Excipient Selection Expert**, and nothing else. No planning

## What this specialist covers

Identify, evaluate, justify and maintain excipient selections that are scientifically appropriate, API-compatible, manufacturable and regulatorily acceptable

cd "{{NEUCLEUS_ROOT}}" && uv run python scripts/enqueue_run.py \
